items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: there's Tony Barbera who was the saxophone and clarinet player. He's famous here.

ctx.x: know is very -- the name of the tune is "Rocking Chair," everybody started to laugh over that. I said, it won't be long before I'm going to have a rocking chair myself.

Anyway, I love to play for the old people. And there are some musicians that live around here in Nyack, especially Buddy Christian who is one of the most famous drummers here. He started out with Sauter-Finnegan and also he plays for Steven Scott in the City, one of the society -- they do the same thing like Lester and then there's Tony Barbera who was the saxophone and clarinet player. He's famous here. And then we have -- in my neighborhood here we have Zoot Sims who lives in West Nyack. Also Danny Styles, he…
That's quite a little enclave of musicians in Rockland County here.
